_about: Jr's own switches. Each flag is turned on by a reviewed PR to this file; the matching repository or runner variable (JR_DEMAND_AUTOMERGE, JR_TICK_AUTOMERGE, JR_CODE_AUTOMERGE, JR_STALL_DISPATCH, JR_PR_FIX_DISPATCH) set to 0 is the instant kill switch that needs no PR. Both must allow before a canary merges anything or the heal launcher is handed a stall or PR-fix incident (SPEC-jr-self-heal.md §5, §1d). build_target_shadow lets jr/build_targets.py publish build-target facts in jr-data PRs (env JR_BUILD_TARGETS=0 kills it); build_target_automerge lets scripts/data_merge.py merge them (env JR_TICK_AUTOMERGE=0 kills it). Both stay false through the 3-day shadow (Jr redesign plan, steps 8-9). backfill_automerge lets scripts/data_merge.py merge Jr's own backfill PRs (jr/tick-*-bf), each board re-derived from the live page by main's code (root-cause plan, 2026-11-26); JR_TICK_AUTOMERGE=0 kills it. It goes on only by its own reviewed PR.
